text:
maria (partnerships): FYI — Lumen Labs finish line: sneak‑peek handoff is set for Tue 09:30 PT. They asked for a lightweight bench + integration checklist. Need NDA status, lab access windows, and who owns the telem hooks. :wave:
sam (eng-ml): I have the signed NDA PDF, uploading to secure drive now. tagging legal for retention note. :white_check_mark:
kevin (solutions): Quick ask — are we shipping them a test image or running on their box? need to know VLAN/KMS access for private runs.
maria (partnerships): Lumen wants us to run the initial bench in their lab (they shipped early hw). Redwood will run our benchmark harness remotely, then hand off the harness to Lumen for validation. We retain telemetry.
jenna (pm): Can we confirm the metric set? target: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, OOM count, and perf delta vs baseline. Also include a qualitative prompt subset for regression checks.
sam (eng-ml): Proposed quick bench command (we'll run first):
```
./run_bench.sh --suite=redwood-mini --model=redwood-v1-8k --precision=fp16 \
  --seq=1024 --concurrency=4 --telemetry=on --out=results/lumen-3591.json
```
kevin (solutions): That works. Also add `--kvcache=true` toggle for one pass. Can Lumen enable SSH jumpbox to the lab from our bastion?
lumen-ops (external): Confirmed: SSH bastion permitted for the test window Tue 09:00–12:00 PT. We'll provide rack access and power bills are stable. NDA & gov forms already signed and shared via link: https://lumen.example.com/nda/abc123
maria (partnerships): Thanks. Legal confirms retention policy OK. Sam — please scrub any customer PII from logs before sharing.
sam (eng-ml): Will anonymize and strip request bodies. I'll push a sanitized results artifact.
kevin (solutions): Telemetry hooks — how verbose should we be? debug traces would be useful but noisy. Suggest sample set: `sys_gpu_util, mem_alloc, tail_latency_hist, rpc_retries` and granularity 1s.
jenna (pm): Keep debug off by default. Enable debug only if we see flakiness. Capture perf counters for the run we hand off.
maria (partnerships): Action items: (1) Sam run bench Tue 09:30 PT; (2) Kevin bring the harness and runbook; (3) Jenna coordinate handoff notes and press embargo window; (4) Lumen to confirm bastion IPs and shipping receipts.
kevin (solutions): I'll bring the runbook and a small USB with the harness and a checksum. Also prepping a short A/B script for quantized vs fp16 runs.
lumen-ops (external): Bastion IPs: 203.0.113.45/32 and 203.0.113.46/32 — we'll add to allowlist tonight. Shipping received: 2 units, serials LX-2001, LX-2002.
sam (eng-ml): Starting the first run now to sanity-check harness (dry-run). I'll post the sanitized results link when done.
deploy-bot: bench-run started by sam on host redwood-runner-4 (job 8342)
sam (eng-ml): Dry-run succeeded, no OOMs. Perf roughly matches baseline locally (within 7%). uploading artifact: https://redwood.internal/bench/8342/sanitized
maria (partnerships): Great. Jenna — when's the PR/press hold lifting? need to know for joint announcement planning.
jenna (pm): Embargo lift: 2026-04-15 16:00 PT tentatively. Legal to confirm. We won't publicize any numbers without partner sign-off.
kevin (solutions): One more technical ask: please enable NTP and sysfs perf counters on the lab hosts. Those are often disabled on lab images.
lumen-ops (external): NTP and perf enabled by default on those boxes; will verify ACLs. Also send me the harness checksum so we can verify the binary.
sam (eng-ml): checksum: sha256: 9f2c4b... (pasted privately).
maria (partnerships): Okay, sound plan. I'll follow up with a short one‑pager handoff doc and post it here. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
jenna (pm): Adding a small checklist for tomorrow: access verification, bench run, sanitized artifact link, telem sample, handoff sign-off.
sam (eng-ml): Will add a tiny regression prompt set (10 prompts) to the artifact.
kevin (solutions): I'll be on-site for the handoff. ping me at +1-415-555-0199 if anything urgent.
lumen-ops (external): We'll have an on-site tech (Ari) meet you at the rack. Looking forward to the sync.
maria (partnerships): Follow-ups: sam/kevin/jenna — please drop final pre-run notes here by EOD Mon. I'll consolidate and share with Lumen.
jenna (pm): Will do. :calendar:
